question.question: What happens to Vagabond pawn when a revolt or another enemy remove-all-pieces effect hits its clearing?

expected.expected_answer: Pawn remains on map and damages three items; it cannot be removed.

source_passages.quotation: **Pawn and items:** Pawn is not a warrior, cannot rule or block rule, and cannot be removed. An enemy effect removing **all enemy pieces** from its clearing instead damages **three items**. Items may be face up (ready) or face down (exhausted), and independently undamaged or damaged. To exhaust for an action, choose a face-up **undamaged** item and flip it down. Damaged items cannot pay actions.

source_passages.section: Woodland Alliance (8); Revolt and Vagabond exception
source_passages.quotation: - **Revolt:** Choose sympathetic clearing without a base, matching a base still on your board. Spend **two matching supporters**. **Remove all enemy pieces there, scoring one normal removal VP per enemy building/token removed**; then place matching base. Place warriors there equal to number of sympathetic clearings matching the base's printed suit (including revolt clearing), and one warrior in Officers box. Resolve the effect even if a prompted placement cannot be completed: place the maximum possible, without adding a base-placement prerequisite. Enemy Vagabond damages three items instead of being removed.

answer.ruling: The Vagabond pawn is not removed; it is not a warrior and cannot be removed. When an enemy effect would remove all enemy pieces from its clearing, instead damage three items. A Revolt follows that Vagabond exception: damage three items instead of removing the pawn.
